label: Exercise Type
description: Kind of practice exercise (pitch matching, scales, rhythm, song sections, etc.).

terms.label: Pitch matching
terms.description: Match single sustained notes played as reference.

terms.label: Intervals
terms.description: Sing the second note of a played interval.

terms.label: Rhythm
terms.description: Reproduce a rhythmic pattern on one pitch.

terms.label: Song section
terms.description: Sing a slice of a song (verse, chorus) against the backing track.

terms.label: Free practice
terms.description: Unstructured singing, full song or improvisation.
